major_changes.title: Possible fraud signal on Jeddah ride-allocation broadcast
major_changes.detail: An MSU shopper and a driver both independently suspect auto-clicker use on the ride-allocation broadcast. DIF shadowing in Amman is confirming the pattern.

major_changes.title: Commission-breakdown visibility is the week's clearest cross-source theme
major_changes.detail: Raised in the driver NPS pulse, the app store review analysis, and directly in the WhatsApp group - drivers want to see the commission split before accepting a ride.

major_changes.title: MSU/DIF fieldwork expanded to a third city
major_changes.detail: 3 of 18 target cities are now live on the MSU survey, up from 2 last week.

recommended_areas: Confirm or rule out the ride-allocation broadcast fraud signal before next week's reporting.
Scope a fix or in-app explainer for commission-breakdown visibility ahead of the September fee update.
Follow up with Odai (DIF - Amman) on the 0-completed-sessions blocker.

major_changes.title: Ride-allocation broadcast concern first surfaced
major_changes.detail: MSU round in Jeddah first flagged the concern later escalated to DIF shadowing in W39.

major_changes.title: Support ticket resolution-time friction confirmed across all diary participants
major_changes.detail: All ten riders in the diary study cited resolution time as their top frustration.

recommended_areas: Scope a follow-up quant survey on support resolution-time expectations.
Schedule DIF shadowing to confirm the Jeddah MSU signal.

major_changes.title: Baseline earnings sentiment established ahead of fee update
major_changes.detail: Driver earnings sentiment survey completed in Jordan ahead of the September commission fee change.

recommended_areas: Re-run the earnings sentiment survey after the fee update lands to measure the shift.
